Harbor Point Mutual Auto Insurance
Bodily Injury Unit
Claim Notes
Claim number:
C-1006
Claimant:
Diane Hernandez
Adjuster:
Valerie Rodriguez
March 29, 2023
First notice of loss received from the claimant, who reports being sideswiped while changing lanes on a multi-lane
road. The claimant states the other vehicle drifted into their lane as they signaled to merge.
April 8, 2023
Confirmed with the policyholder that the driver at the time of loss is listed on the policy and the vehicle is covered
under the current term. No concerns noted with coverage status.
May 25, 2023
Spoke with the claimant, who described the same sequence of events as in the initial report. The account was
consistent on the point of impact and the position of both vehicles.
July 13, 2023
Obtained the police report, which confirms the claimant was present in the vehicle at the scene and records the
lane-change sideswipe. Responding officer noted the other driver's admission of being in the adjacent lane.
August 18, 2023
Reviewed photographs submitted by the claimant and taken at the scene. Damage along the driver-side panel lines
up with the described impact, and no earlier damage to the vehicle is known from prior records.
August 28, 2023
Took statements from two witnesses who saw the collision. Both describe the other vehicle moving laterally into the
claimant's lane, matching the claimant's account and the other driver's statement.
September 27, 2023
Claimant reports shoulder pain from the impact and has begun treatment. The injury is a plausible result of a
sideswipe of this kind, and no prior injury to the same area is known.
October 20, 2023
Treatment has followed a typical cousre with physical therapy and periodic check-ins. The claimant reports steady
improvement, and the frequency of visits has been tapering as expected.
October 24, 2023
Contacted the claimant for a status update. Recovery is progressing, the claimant is returning to normal activities, and
the account of the accident remains unchanged from the first report.
November 1, 2023
Reviewed the file as a whole. Accident facts, vehicle damage, witness accounts and the injury are all consistent with
one another, and nothing in the record suggests the damage predates the policy start. File remains open pending
final treatment records.
</page>

List the facts written on this page. Copy each value exactly as it is written: same spelling,
punctuation and date format. Do not add anything that is not on this page. Use "" for a missing value.

Person "role" must be one of: claimant, attorney, defense_attorney, expert, doctor, officer, adjuster, witness, other.
  claimant = the person who made the claim (also called patient, plaintiff, client, customer,
  or the driver who reported it). attorney = a lawyer for the claimant or plaintiff.
  defense_attorney = a lawyer for the insurance company or defendant.
Organization "type" must be one of: repair_shop, clinic, law_firm, court, insurer, police, other.
"policy_numbers" = only values labeled as a policy number. A claim number is not a policy number.
"street" and "city" = the person's own home address, only if the page gives it. Never use the
address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
